note: Re-baselined 2026-08-15 against the live toon_v2 (2997 entries: eng=2618, rag=363, prompt=14, llm=1, spec=1, eng_design=0). Supersedes corpus-1.0 (built 2026-06-18 against a 1314-entry snapshot whose 8086/DOS/EDA/llm targets the corpus no longer holds — corpus-1.0 scored 13.6% coverage on 2026-08-15, a pure snapshot mismatch, not a retrieval regression). The corpus reshaped heavily via /research: eng ballooned with homelab/Proxmox/networking ingests + Wikipedia topic dumps; the llm partition collapsed to 1 entry and eng_design emptied to 0 (likely a compose-down wipe, only eng/rag repopulated). Every pair here targets a title that EXISTS in the current corpus and is verified to retrieve in the top-10 via scripts/score_retrieval.py. expected_titles_contain is a case-insensitive AND of substrings (§17.230 matching) — robust to the re-ingested lowercased title variants observed (e.g. 'v1910-cli-vlan-configuration'); expected_entry_ids left empty (non-deterministic across re-ingestion, §17.211/§17.229). Domains assigned so each target sits in the queried partition. eng_design omitted (empty partition). Purpose: a non-zero before/after yardstick for retrieval changes (e.g. BM25 cutover).

measured_baseline.note: 100% coverage by design (every pair verified present); MRR/precision < 1.0 because several homelab targets rank behind near-duplicate siblings (many OPNsense/Proxmox/Palworld/Plex-passthrough variants) — intentional ranking headroom so the yardstick can detect both regressions (coverage/rank drops) and improvements (rank climbs).
